svg.text: OpMode: Auton Red Near or Auton Blue Near
Robot's BACK against our alliance wall, next to the LOADING ZONE.
Drives by TIME (TimedAuton.java: FORWARD_S, RIGHT_S, BACK_S). The positions below are the GOALS: forward 23, right 12, back 18 in.
Same as the SET UP line on the INIT screen
Filled box = START (arrow = FRONT, black bar = BACK on the wall). Numbered circles = waypoints. Dashed box = where it PARKS.
Robot size used: 17.98 x 15.99 in (BasicAuton.ROBOT_LENGTH_IN / ROBOT_WIDTH_IN). Blue = Red rotated 180° (decision 011).
HIVE: the UP CELLS shown are at MATCH START (Red: audience side, Blue: far side). Every TIP flips which CELL is up.
Robot set up here. Nothing moves during INIT
LEAVE: 23 in forward, off the red wall (y 63 -> 40)
12 in RIGHT, toward the audience (x 60 -> 48), in front of the LOADING ZONE
PARK: 18 in back (y 40 -> 58), into the LOADING ZONE. Back edge at y 67, 5 in
Test log: 5 good runs in a row = ready for competition
Field positions approximate. Source: BIOBUZZ Competition Manual Section 9. Generated by TeamCode/docs/game/diagrams/make_diagrams.py
